source_metadata.author: MargaretToigo
source_metadata.description: This is a pair of gloves that will fit most humans. One diffuse texture is included. Illustration shows gloves with subsurf of two.

observed.mhmat_text:
# MakeHuman Material definition

name gloves03Material

// Color shading attributes
diffuseColor  0.64 0.64 0.64
specularColor  0.1 0.1 0.1
shininess 0.1725
opacity 1

// Textures and properties
diffuseTexture Gloves03UV.png

// Shader programme
shader data/shaders/glsl/phong

// Configure built-in shader defines
shaderConfig diffuse true
shaderConfig bump false
shaderConfig normal  false
shaderConfig displacement  false
shaderConfig spec  false
shaderConfig vertexColors false

assets.license_review: ELIGIBLE_CC0_ISOLATED_ADAPTATION: official page and pack registry agree with OBJ and MHCLO CC0 declarations; material maps inherit pack-level CC0 listing and carry no conflicting embedded license.

source_metadata.author: MargaretToigo
source_metadata.description: This is a pair of ankle boots that will fit most male humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. These boots have the same UV mapping as my Ankle Boots http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/ankle_boots.html . Illustration shows boots with subsurf of two and a mean crease of one around the heel and sole edge loops.

observed.mhmat_text:
# MakeHuman Material definition

name ankleboots.mMaterial

// Color shading attributes
diffuseColor  0.64 0.64 0.64
specularColor  0.2 0.2 0.2
shininess 1
opacity 1

// Textures and properties
diffuseTexture BootsAnkleM.png
normalmapTexture BootsAnkle-norm.png
specularmapTexture BootsAnkle-spec.png

// Shader programme
shader data/shaders/glsl/phong

// Configure built-in shader defines
shaderConfig diffuse true
shaderConfig bump false
shaderConfig normal true
shaderConfig displacement  false
shaderConfig spec true
shaderConfig vertexColors false

assets.license_review: ELIGIBLE_CC0_ISOLATED_ADAPTATION: official page and pack registry agree with OBJ and MHCLO CC0 declarations; material maps inherit pack-level CC0 listing and carry no conflicting embedded license.
